brief:
The United States is set to deliver $2.8 billion worth of military equipment to Israel, according to Al Jazeera English. The shipment represents a major arms transfer at a time of heightened regional tensions.

A 15-year-old boy was killed in a double-tap strike while attempting to rescue a paramedic, the outlet reported. Double-tap strikes—successive attacks on the same location—are a documented tactic that targets first responders and civilians gathering at impact sites.

title: US approves $2.8 billion weapons shipment to Israel
